description: Implementation of OSWindow for OSX, including window creation, event handling, and input processing using Cocoa and Carbon APIs.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: NSApplication subclass handling event forwarding to custom windows.

classes.name: ApplicationDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for application-wide events, manages termination and focus events.

classes.name: ContentView
classes.description: Custom NSView handling input events and forwarding them to the window.

classes.name: WindowDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for window events such as resize, move, close, and focus changes.

classes.name: OSXWindow
classes.description: Implementation of OSWindow for OSX, managing window creation, event loop, and input.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OSX window with specified name, width, and height.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with the window.

methods.name: getNativeWindow
methods.description: Returns the native window layer for EGL or other native interfacing.

methods.name: getNativeDisplay
methods.description: Returns the native display type (not implemented).

methods.name: messageLoop
methods.description: Processes pending events in a loop.

methods.name: setMousePosition
methods.description: Sets the mouse cursor position within the window.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the window position on the screen.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the window to specified dimensions.

methods.name: signalTestEvent
methods.description: Posts a test event to the event queue.
